issues.exact_quote: the envelope cube of each superpixel block obtained via superpixel segmentation is regarded as the fundamental unit for computing the low rank approximation
issues.reason_zh: 方法实质采用超像素分割来划分低秩近似的基本计算单元，属于图像分割方法；不要求分割本身为新贡献。

issues.exact_quote: Finally, an iterative update algorithm is proposed to solve the low rank and noise terms using the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM).
issues.reason_zh: 方法将观测图像分解为低秩与噪声项，并恢复去噪后的低秩图像分量用于分类，属于从污染观测恢复数据，不只是分类器鲁棒性改进。
